rationale: The stock gapped up 13.5% on elevated volume but is now consolidating below the 9-EMA ($22.39) with the last few candles showing a mild drift lower, suggesting the initial momentum is fading. A securities fraud class action filed within the last 75 minutes introduces severe headline risk — further negative developments could trigger sharp selling, while short-side entries risk a squeeze given the already-elevated short interest implied by the lawsuit catalyst. The wide bid-ask spread (54 bps) and ambiguous near-term direction make the risk/reward unattractive in either direction.
